case_number: Civil Appeal No. 500 of 2022 along with Civil Appeals Nos. 501-506 of 2022

parties.respondent: V.K. Senthil & Ors. (and other respondents in consolidated appeals)

summary: Appellant/defendant challenged High Court's dismissal of civil revision petitions concerning applications to reject plaints under Order VII Rule 11 CPC, alleging suits for cancellation of 2005 sale deeds were time-barred. Respondents/plaintiffs claimed deeds were procured by fraud as they were misled into believing documents were Joint Development Agreements. Key issues: applicability of Section 17 of Limitation Act regarding fraud discovery, proper stage to determine limitation (trial vs. preliminary objection). Court examined whether vague fraud allegations could extend limitation period beyond 10 years from execution date (2005-2016).
